messages:
elena: OrionCompute confirmed co-lab availability next Thurs for a perf/W and kernel-tuning sweep. They asked for a clear artifact list and a short run script. Can we assign owners? cc @priya @dan @lucas

priya: I can take comms with Orion and handle image distribution. I will push two images: redwood/runtime:2.7-orion and redwood/runtime:2.7-orion-quant. Also will export a manifest with digest and public ghcr links. ETA Tue.

dan: I'll handle kernel variants + perf counters. Planning three variants: stock, energy-aware-sched, and bigpages+prefetch. Will include a build tag and sha. Perf counters: SM active, mem_bw, l2_hit_rate, and PCIe bandwidth.

lucas: Ops/telemetry here. We need wall meter serial (Wattsense-2) and host RAPL readings. Will coordinate with their rack admin to map wall-meter -> host. I'll also bring a small prometheus job and a collector that merges nvidia-smi + ipmi + /proc/rapl.

elena: For workloads: test models gptj and small-llama (7B). Seq lengths: 512, 1536. Batches: 1 and 8. Also run a cache-primed workload and a cold-start workload. Two passes: controlled P-state (partner recommended) and max-performance uncapped.

priya: Suggest run-id naming: ORION-<YYYYMMDD>-<RUNID>. Experiment matrix fields: run_id,date,model,image,kernel,seq,batch,pstate,capped,wall_meter,notes. I'll create a google sheet and share.

dan: Kernel build snippet for reproducibility:
```bash
# build kernel variant
make -j16 KERNEL_TAG=energy_aware CONFIG=release
# export sha
git rev-parse --short HEAD > /results/kernel_sha.txt
```
Telemetry notes:
```bash
# nvidia slow sample
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,power.draw,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv -lms 200 > /results/gpu.csv &
# IPMI wall meter poll (Wattsense-2)
while true; do ipmitool sdr get "Wattsense-2"; sleep 0.5; done > /results/wall.csv &
# collect RAPL (host power)
./tools/rapl-collector --interval 200ms > /results/rapl.csv &
```

lucas: Run harness (example) to include in repo:
```bash
export RUN_ID=ORION-2026-0421-01
docker run --rm --gpus all -e RUN_ID -e SEQ=1536 -e BATCH=1 -v /results:/results ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2.7-orion ./bench_runner.sh --model gptj --tokens 80000 --warmup 30000
```
Make sure to set RUN_ID before starting. Upload raw /results to gs://redwood-orion/$RUN_ID afterwards.

elena: Ops checklist: 1) dry-run in Redwood lab (Mon), 2) push images & kernel artifacts (Tue), 3) deliver runbook + matrix to Orion (Wed), 4) partner run (Thu), 5) upload raw traces (Thu end), 6) analysis (Fri). If dry-run deviates >12% perf/W from baseline pause and escalate.

priya: Legal & marketing: please don’t publish any numbers publicly until we have partner-approved language. I'll loop legal and draft a short joint statement template.

dan: Postproc plan: small python script that merges gpu.csv + wall.csv + harness.json to compute tokens/sec, avg W, and perf_per_W (tokens/sec per watt). I'll push to tools/bench/orion_postproc.py.

lucas: Also capture BIOS power caps and firmware versions. I'll take a screenshot of BIOS power config and store it under /results/meta/bios.txt.

elena: Owners confirmed: priya=images & comms, dan=kernels & postproc, lucas=telemetry & infra, elena=runbook & partner liaison. Please upload artifacts to gs://redwood-orion/$RUN_ID and set ACLs for orion-team@orioncompute.com.

infra-bot: Rack booking confirmed for ORION-LAB-17 on Thu 09:00-18:00. Ticket ORN-7602.

priya: I'll share the sheet and image digests by EOD Tue. Dan/Lucas, can you both drop your 5-step run instructions as gists here by Wed morning?

dan: Will do. Lucas + I will also schedule a 30m pre-run sync with Orion on Wed 16:00 to confirm meter mapping and SSH keys.

elena: Thanks team  once we have dry-run data we can lock the comms. Ping here for any blockers. :white_check_mark:
